# R14b fixtures (synthetic)

Generated by `tests/fixtures/post_de/design_factory.py` (seeded standard-library Gaussian values; no study data).

- `sex_three_groups(variant=...)`: groups A, B, C (8 units each) x sex. Sex shifts F01-F06 by +1.2 for males, group B
  shifts F01-F03 and F07-F09 by +1.0 and group C shifts F10-F12 by -1.2. Variants: `partial` (A 2M/6F, B 6M/2F, C 4M/4F,
  so part of the B-A effect is a sex effect), `balanced`, `confounded` (C entirely male: the group x sex interaction has
  an empty cell) and `one_male` (A has a single male, so the male subgroup fails the coverage rule).
- `unbalanced_with_injections()`: 31 A vs 11 B units with B-A effects on F01-F08; unit B1 is measured by two technical
  injections (aggregated to one biological unit) and is a planted high-leverage unit (+3 on F01-F04).
